sources.title: minhtoan/t5-translation-vietnamese-nom · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Today, Nôm is a specialized field, and efforts are made to preserve its knowledge. Though modern Vietnamese uses the Latin alphabet, Nôm remains an integral part of Vietnam's cultural heritage. State-of-the-art lightweights pretrained Transformer-based encoder-decoder model for Vietnamese Nom translation.

sources.title: GitHub - HiIamPhuc/ChineseNom-translator-by-transformer
sources.snippet: ChineseNom-translator-by-transformer This repository contains a Chinese-Nom translation system built using the MT5 transformer model. The project is designed to translate Chinese-Nom text into Vietnamese using a pre-trained MT5 model fine-tuned for this specific task.

sources.title: GitHub - google-research/multilingual-t5
sources.snippet: Multilingual T5 (mT5) is a massively multilingual pretrained text-to-text transformer model, trained following a similar recipe as T5. This repo can be used to reproduce the experiments in the mT5 paper.

sources.title: Google Translate
sources.snippet: Google's service, offered free of charge, instantly translates words, phrases, and web pages between English and over 100 other languages.
